title: WBCA Pauses Stars & Stripes Air Show in 2027, Plans Return in 2028
excerpt: The Washington's Birthday Celebration Association says the Stars & Stripes Air Show Spectacular will pause in 2027 and return in 2028, moving to every other year going forward.
content:
The Washington's Birthday Celebration Association (WBCA) says the Stars & Stripes Air Show Spectacular will pause in 2027, with plans to return bigger and better in 2028.

The association announced the decision Friday, Nov. 20, saying it was made after careful consideration. Moving forward, the air show will take place every other year, so the community can keep enjoying the event at the scale it is known for.

WBCA thanked its sponsors, volunteers, partners and the Laredo community for their support and understanding, and said the show will be back in 2028.

More information is available at thewbcaairshow.org.

Source: Washington's Birthday Celebration Association, Nov. 20, 2026; thewbcaairshow.org.
